name: Export contacts
description: Call this when you need to generate a CSV/Excel export of one or more contacts, optionally including subscription status and internal metadata. Use the action that checks export progress and retrieves the file once it is ready, instead of calling export again.
preconditions: The contacts referenced by the provided ids must exist.

ids.description: Array of contact IDs to export. Required when is_all_selected is false.

is_all_selected.description: If true, export all contacts matching the current filter instead of the ids list.

fe_query.description: Frontend query object representing additional filtering criteria.

searchBy.description: Search term applied to contacts before export.

attributes.description: List of contact attributes/columns to include in the export.

exportInternalMetaData.description: Internal metadata fields to include, expressed as SQL‑like aliases.

sourceId.description: Optional source identifier for the export request.

sourceType.description: Optional source type for the export request.

send_email.description: If true, an email containing the export link will be sent to the user.

message.description: Confirmation that the export job has been dispatched.

side_effects: An export job is queued and processed asynchronously.
If send_email is true, an email with a download link is sent to the requesting user.
